newsitem.title: POLAND: MOSTOSTAL GETS PLN 3.1 MLN PAYOUT.
newsitem.headline: MOSTOSTAL GETS PLN 3.1 MLN PAYOUT.

text.p: Polish construction and trading firm Mostostal Export SA has received 3.1 million zlotys in the third tranche of a dividend payment from bank leasing society Bankowe Towarzystwo Leasingowe SA (BTL), Mostostal said.
Mostostal said in a statement on Monday that it had so far received 12.1 million zlotys in dividends from BTL, all of which would appear in April's earnings result.
BTL, which is 69-percent owned by Mostostal, decided to allocate its entire 30.2-million-zloty profit in 1995-1996 to dividend payments.
